units.title: Durable workers and quality/cost evaluation
units.acceptanceCriteria: Verify required behavior, rejection paths, source-bound test evidence and private defaults; live acceptance remains separate.
units.implementationStatus: Partial: durable UTF8 text job submission, leases, one-shot consumption, trusted current authorization/exact outcome verification and transactional audit/outbox. Dispatch daemon, object/receipt service integration, OCR/model workers, quality/cost evaluation and live acceptance remain pending. PR7 adds optional trusted terminal stopped/no-output reconciliation, exact receipt binding and safe replay without automatic retry. Qualified receipt services remain pending. PR8 adds disposable PostgreSQL17 restricted-network-session contention tests for ledger invariants; specific CI evidence does not establish production deployment acceptance. PR9 adds explicit manager-only retry lineage after fresh exact stopped/no-output verification, one deterministic child per immutable failed parent edition, fresh child start checks, atomic audit/outbox and a sixteen-generation cap. Production proof services, daemon and full worker qualification remain pending. PR10 adds a single-leased-job UTF8 runner joining acknowledged consumption, exact clean/authorized source callbacks, accepted extraction, private text storage callbacks and independently verified ledger completion. Real gateway/object/receipt implementations, daemon and deployed qualification remain pending. PR11 connects the source side to the authenticated Evidence facade with current processing-policy callbacks, before/after metadata checks and exact verified encrypted-object bytes; separate DB ownership and the stable persistence pin remain. Production source/output/receipt service deployment and live qualification remain pending. PR12 adds Processing-owned encrypted text outputs, durable pre-blob intents, atomic private artifact/receipt/outbox publication, exact committed-outcome recovery and independent current-source re-extraction/persisted-byte verification. Pending intent finalization/orphan cleanup, deployed keys/filesystem/gateway qualification and output network-session/crash acceptance remain pending.
